cohort: The study participants were patients with single, euploid, frozen embryo transfers (FETs) using autologous oocytes who underwent intracytoplasmic sperm injection and preimplantation genetic testing for aneuploidy at a single IVF institution.
finding: IVF pregnancies with a chorionic bump (CB) showed an increased risk of clinical loss, but if the pregnancy persists, it is likely to result in a full-term delivery without additional pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: No association was found between chorionic bump and mode of delivery.
